university: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Rohilkhand University (MJPRU), Bareilly

units.title: Introduction & Overview of Python Programming
topics: History and Evolution of Python: Guido van Rossum, Design Philosophy, Python 2 vs Python 3
Core Characteristics of Python: Interpreted, High-Level, Dynamically Typed, Cross-Platform
Python Interpreter Architecture: CPython, JIT (PyPy), Bytecode (.pyc) Compilation, Python Virtual Machine (PVM)
Interactive Python Shell, REPL Environment, IDLE & Command Line Execution Modes
Structure of a Python Script: Header, Shebang (#/usr/bin/env python), Module Imports, Main Function Idiom (__name__ == '__main__')
Python Indentation Paradigm: Whitespace Rules, Syntactic Code Blocks vs Braces in C/Java
Lexical Elements and Atoms: Python Keywords (import keyword; keyword.kwlist), Valid Identifiers, Naming Conventions (PEP 8)
Python Literals: Integer, Float, Complex Numbers (a + bj), Boolean (True/False), NoneType Singleton
Python Strings: Single, Double, Triple Quotes (Docstrings), Raw Strings (r'\n'), Escape Sequences
String Indexing & Advanced Slicing: Positive/Negative Indices, Slicing [start:stop:step], Immutability of Strings
String Formatting Techniques: % Operator, str.format() Method, Formatted String Literals (f-strings)
Basic Console I/O: input() Function, Type Conversion (int(), float()), print() Function (sep, end parameters)

units.title: Operators, Expressions & Creating Python Programs
topics: Arithmetic Operators: Addition (+), Subtraction (-), Multiplication (*), True Division (/), Floor Division (//), Modulo (%), Exponentiation (**)
Relational / Comparison Operators: ==, !=, >, <, >=, <=, Chained Comparisons (a < b < c)
Logical Operators: and, or, not (Short-Circuit Evaluation Semantics)
Bitwise Operators: Bitwise AND (&), OR (|), XOR (^), Inversion (~), Left Shift (<<), Right Shift (>>)
Assignment and Augmented Operators: =, +=, -=, *=, /=, //=, %=, **=
Identity and Membership Operators: is vs == (Object Identity vs Value Equality), in and not in Operators
Ternary Conditional Expression: x if condition else y Syntax and Precedence
Operator Precedence & Associativity Hierarchy: BEDMAS / PEMDAS Order of Evaluation
Python Collection Primitives: Lists (Mutable, Ordered, Indexable), List Methods (append, extend, pop, sort)
Tuples: Immutable Sequences, Packing and Unpacking, Single Element Tuple Syntax (1,)
Dictionaries (dict): Key-Value Mappings, Hashing Requirements, Dict Methods (keys, values, items, get, update)
Sets (set): Unordered Unique Elements, Set Operations (Union |, Intersection &, Difference -, Symmetric Difference ^)

units.title: Decision Making, Branching, Iteration & Functions
topics: Conditional Branching: if Statement, if-else Statement, if-elif-else Ladder Architecture
Nested Decision Structures and Truth Value Testing (Truthy and Falsy Values)
While Loop: Entry-Controlled Iteration, Infinite Loops, while-else Construct Execution Semantics
For Loop: Sequence Iteration, range(start, stop, step) Generator, for-else Construct Execution Semantics
Loop Control Jump Statements: break (Immediate Loop Termination), continue (Skip Current Iteration), pass (Null Statement)
List Comprehensions: Compact Syntax [expr for item in iterable if condition], Nested Comprehensions
Dictionary and Set Comprehensions: {k: v for ...} and {x for ...}
Defining Functions in Python: def Keyword, Function Signature, docstrings (__doc__)
Function Parameters and Arguments: Positional Arguments, Keyword Arguments, Default Parameter Trap (Mutable Defaults)
Arbitrary Variable-Length Arguments: *args (Positional Tuple) and **kwargs (Keyword Dictionary)
Variable Scope & Lifetime: LEGB Rule (Local, Enclosing, Global, Built-in), global and nonlocal Keywords
Functional Programming Primitives: Anonymous Functions (lambda), map(), filter(), reduce() (functools)

units.title: Classes, Objects, Inheritance & Advanced OOP
topics: Object-Oriented Philosophy in Python: Classes as Types, Everything is an Object
Class Definition: class Keyword, Instance Attributes vs Class Attributes, Self Parameter Mechanics
Constructor & Destructor Methods: __init__() Initializer, __new__() Allocator, __del__() Finalizer
Encapsulation and Information Hiding: Public Members, Protected (_var Convention), Private (__var Name Mangling)
Property Decorators: @property, @setter, @deleter for Controlled Attribute Access
Inheritance Architecture: Single Inheritance, Multilevel Inheritance, Hierarchical Inheritance, Multiple Inheritance
Method Resolution Order (MRO): C3 Superclass Linearization Algorithm, ClassName.__mro__, super() Function
Polymorphism & Duck Typing: 'If it walks like a duck and quacks like a duck, it is a duck'
Method Overriding vs Method Overloading: Why Python Does Not Support Native Overloading (Dispatch by Default/args)
Operator Overloading & Dunder (Magic) Methods: __str__, __repr__, __add__, __sub__, __mul__, __eq__, __len__, __getitem__
Class Composition and Aggregation: HAS-A Relationships vs IS-A Inheritance
Abstract Base Classes (abc Module): @abstractmethod Decorator, Enforcing Contractual Subclass Implementations

units.title: Iterators, Generators, Web Scraping & Testing
topics: Iteration Protocol: Iterable vs Iterator, __iter__() and __next__() Methods, StopIteration Exception
Custom Iterator Implementation: Building State-Tracking Iterable Classes
Generators in Python: yield Statement, Generator Functions, Execution Pausing and Resumption State
Generator Expressions: Memory-Efficient Lazy Stream Evaluation (expr for item in iterable)
Python Exception Handling: try, except, else, finally Blocks, Exception Hierarchy (BaseException, Exception)
Raising and Creating Custom Exceptions: raise Statement, Subclassing Exception Class
Assertions in Python: assert Statement, AssertionError, Debugging Flag (-O Flag Optimization)
Python Testing and Debugging: pdb (Python Debugger - n, s, c, p commands), unittest Framework (TestCase, assertEqual)
Web Scraping Fundamentals: HTTP Requests Protocol, RESTful APIs, urllib vs requests Library (GET, POST, Headers)
HTML Parsing with Beautiful Soup (bs4): Soup Objects, NavigableStrings, Tag Finding (find, find_all, select CSS Selectors)
Data Extraction & Sanitization: Scraping Tables, Attributes, Text Content, Handling Pagination
Ethical Web Scraping Practices: robots.txt Compliance, Request Throttling, User-Agent Headers, Rate Limiting

units.title: Unix Architecture, Commands & Process Management
topics: History and Evolution of UNIX: Ken Thompson, Dennis Ritchie, Bell Labs, BSD, POSIX, Linux Foundation
Salient Features of UNIX: Multi-user, Multitasking, Portability, Hierarchical File System, Tool-Building Philosophy
UNIX System Architecture: Hardware Layer, Kernel Layer, System Call Interface, Shell Layer, Application Utilities
UNIX Command Syntax & Format: Command Name, Options (Flags -a, --long), Command Arguments, Standard Output
Internal (Built-in) vs External (Disk-Based) Commands: type Command, which Command, Command Path Hash Table
General Utilities & Help Facilities: man Pages (Sections 1-8), whatis, apropos, date, cal, echo, clear, banner
Directory Management Commands: pwd, mkdir (-p flag), rmdir, cd (Path Traversal . and ..)
File Manipulation Commands: ls (Options -l, -a, -R, -t, -h), touch, cp (-r, -i), mv, rm (-r, -f), cat, more, less, head, tail (-f)
Disk & System Status Commands: df (-h), du (-sh), free, uname (-a), who, w, whoami, id, uptime
UNIX Process Management: Process Concept, PID, PPID, Process States (Running, Sleeping, Stopped, Zombie), ps Command (aux, -ef)
Process Scheduling & Background Execution: Ampersand (&), nohup, jobs, fg, bg, nice, renice Priorities (-20 to 19)
Process Termination & Signals: kill Command, killall, Standard Signals (SIGTERM 15, SIGKILL 9, SIGINT 2, SIGHUP 1), top Command

units.title: Unix File System, Inodes & Storage Administration
topics: Hierarchical File System Architecture: Root (/), /bin, /sbin, /etc, /dev, /home, /lib, /tmp, /usr, /var
UNIX File Types: Regular (Ordinary) Files (-), Directories (d), Character Devices (c), Block Devices (b), FIFO Pipes (p), Sockets (s), Links (l)
Physical Disk Architecture in UNIX: Boot Block, Super Block, Inode Table (ILIST), Data Blocks
The Super Block: File System Metadata, Total Free Inodes, Free Data Block Pointer Lists, File System State Flags
The UNIX Inode: Inode Number (ls -i), Inode Structure, File Attributes, Direct Pointers (0-11), Indirect Pointers (Single, Double, Triple)
In-Core Inode vs Disk Inode: Active File Tracking, Reference Counts, Mount Point Crossing
Directory Implementation: Directory Entries as (Filename, Inode Number) Pairs, Conversion of Pathname to Inode
Hard Links vs Symbolic (Soft) Links: ln vs ln -s, Inode Sharing, Cross-Filesystem Constraints, Dangling Links
Secondary Storage Management: Disk Partitioning (fdisk, parted), Creating Filesystems (mkfs, mke2fs)
Mounting & Unmounting Filesystems: mount Command, umount Command, /etc/fstab Configuration Table
Checking & Repairing Filesystems: fsck Utility, Bad Block Detection, Disk Compression Utilities (gzip, gunzip, bzip2, tar -cvf, tar -xvf)
UNIX System Calls: open, creat, read, write, lseek, close, fork, exec, wait, exit, pipe System Calls

units.title: Special Tools, Filters & Stream Editors (grep, sed, awk)
topics: Standard I/O Streams in UNIX: Standard Input (stdin, 0), Standard Output (stdout, 1), Standard Error (stderr, 2)
Redirection Operators: Output Redirection (> and >>), Input Redirection (<), Error Redirection (2>, 2>&1)
UNIX Pipelines: Pipeline (|) Operator, Chaining Multiple Programs, The tee Utility (Splitting Output Stream)
Basic Filter Commands: sort (-n, -r, -k), uniq (-c, -d), cut (-d, -f, -c), paste, tr (Character Translation and Deletion)
Information Filters: wc (Word, Line, Byte Count), comm, diff, cmp, find Utility (Searching by Name, Type, Size, Exec Action)
Regular Expressions in UNIX: Basic Regular Expressions (BRE) vs Extended Regular Expressions (ERE)
Regex Metacharacters: Anchors (^, $), Wildcard (.), Character Classes ([abc], [^0-9]), Quantifiers (*, +, ?, {m,n}), Grouping ()
Pattern Searching with grep: grep, egrep (grep -E), fgrep (grep -F), Options (-i, -v, -n, -c, -l, -w)
Stream Editor (sed) Architecture: Non-Interactive Stream Processing, Pattern Space and Hold Buffer
sed Commands: Substitution (s/pattern/replacement/flags - g, p), Deletion (d), Printing (p), Appending (a), Inserting (i)
The AWK Programming Language: Pattern-Action Structure (pattern { action }), Built-in Variables (FS, OFS, RS, ORS, NR, NF, FILENAME)
AWK Scripting Constructs: BEGIN and END Blocks, Field Referencing ($0, $1..$NF), Formatted Printing (printf), Conditionals and Loops

units.title: vi Editor, Shell Environment & Scripting Fundamentals
topics: Text Editing in UNIX: The vi / vim Editor, Operational Modes (Command Mode, Insert Mode, Last-Line / Ex Mode)
vi Cursor Navigation & Editing Commands: h, j, k, l, w, b, 0, $, gg, G, i, a, o, x, dd, yy, p, u, Ctrl-R
vi Search, Replace & Save Commands: /pattern, ?pattern, :s/old/new/g, :%s/old/new/gc, :w, :q, :wq, :q!
Shell Architecture & Types: Bourne Shell (sh), C Shell (csh), Korn Shell (ksh), Bourne-Again Shell (bash), Z Shell (zsh)
Shell Command-Line Processing: Tokenization, History Expansion, Alias Substitution, Parameter Expansion, Filename Globbing (*, ?, [a-z])
Writing and Executing a Shell Script: Shebang line (#!/bin/bash), Execution Permissions (chmod +x), ./script.sh vs sh script.sh
Shell Variables: User-Defined Variables, Assignment Syntax (var=val, No Spaces), Variable Dereferencing ($var, ${var})
System & Environment Variables: HOME, PATH, USER, SHELL, PWD, PS1, export Command, Environment Persistence (~/.bashrc, ~/.bash_profile)
Console Input and Output in Scripts: echo (-e, -n), read Statement (Options -p, -s, -t), Command Substitution ($(cmd) and `cmd`)
Arithmetic Evaluation in Shell: expr Command, Double Parentheses (( expression )), let Command, bc (Arbitrary Precision Calculator)
Positional Parameters & Special Script Arguments: $0 (Script Name), $1..$9, ${10}, $# (Arg Count), $* vs $@, $? (Exit Status), $$ (PID)
Conditional Testing with test Command: Bracket Syntax [ condition ] vs [[ extended condition ]], File Tests (-f, -d, -r, -w, -x, -s)
String & Numeric Comparison Tests: String Tests (=, !=, -z, -n), Integer Tests (-eq, -ne, -lt, -le, -gt, -ge)

units.title: Control Structures, Functions & System Administration
topics: Conditional Control Structures: Simple if-then-fi, if-then-else-fi, if-then-elif-else-fi Multi-Way Branching
Pattern Matching with case Statement: case $var in pattern1) ... ;; pattern2) ... ;; *) ... ;; esac Architecture
Looping Structures - while Loop: Condition-Based Entry-Controlled Iteration, Infinite while Loops
Looping Structures - until Loop: Iterating Until Condition Evaluates to True
Looping Structures - for Loop: Word List Iteration (for var in list; do ... done), C-Style For Loop (for ((i=0; i<n; i++)))
Jumping Control Structures: break (Exit Loop), break n (Break Nested Loops), continue (Skip to Next Iteration), exit status
Shell Functions: Defining Functions (fname() { ... }), Passing Arguments to Functions ($1, $2 inside functions), return vs echo Output
File Descriptors and Advanced I/O Redirection: Custom File Descriptors (exec 3<file), Here Documents (<<EOF), Here Strings (<<<)
Signal Trapping in Scripts: trap Command, Handling SIGINT (Ctrl-C), Cleaning Up Temporary Files on Script Abort
UNIX File Permissions & Security: User, Group, Others (rwx), Octal Notation (chmod 755, 644), chown, chgrp, umask Mechanics
System Administration & Automation: Cron Daemon, crontab File Format (* * * * * command), at Command for Single Execution
Backup & Archival Scripting: Automated Log Rotation, Compression Scripts, Remote Copying with scp and rsync

units.title: Introduction to Accountancy, Journal & Ledger
topics: Introduction to Accountancy: Definition of Accounting, Book-keeping vs Accounting, Objectives of Accounting
Advantages and Limitations of Financial Accounting, Users of Accounting Information (Internal vs External)
Accounting Principles, Concepts & Conventions: Entity Concept, Money Measurement, Going Concern, Accounting Period Concept
Cost Concept, Dual Aspect Concept, Realization Concept, Accrual Concept, Matching Principle, Full Disclosure, Materiality, Prudence (Conservatism)
Double Entry System of Book-Keeping: Fundamental Philosophy, Advantages, Classification of Accounts (Personal, Real, Nominal)
Rules of Debit and Credit: Traditional British Approach (Golden Rules: Personal, Real, Nominal Accounts)
Modern American Accounting Equation Approach: Assets = Liabilities + Capital; Debit/Credit Rules for Assets, Liabilities, Capital, Revenues, Expenses
The Journal: Meaning, Format, Source Documents (Vouchers, Invoices), Compound Journal Entries, Trade Discount vs Cash Discount
The Accounting Equation: Effect of Business Transactions on Accounting Equation, Balancing the Equation
Ledger Accounts: Meaning, Importance, Difference between Journal and Ledger, Ledger Account Format (T-Account)
Ledger Posting Mechanics: Posting Debit and Credit Entries from Journal to Respective Ledger Accounts, Balancing of Ledger Accounts
Cash Book: Meaning, Types (Single Column, Double Column, Three Column Cash Book with Cash, Bank, and Discount Columns), Petty Cash Book (Imprest System)

units.title: Trial Balance & Financial Statements (with Adjustments)
topics: Trial Balance: Meaning, Definition, Special Features, Objectives, Limitations (Errors Not Disclosed by Trial Balance)
Methods of Preparing Trial Balance: Total Method, Balance Method, Total-and-Balance Method
Classification of Errors in Accounting: Errors of Omission, Errors of Commission, Errors of Principle, Compensating Errors
Suspense Account: Purpose, Rectification of Single-Sided and Double-Sided Errors before and after Trial Balance
Financial Statements (Final Accounts): Objectives, Structure, Distinction between Capital Expenditure and Revenue Expenditure
Trading Account: Meaning, Purpose, Format, Calculation of Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), Gross Profit or Gross Loss
Profit and Loss Account: Meaning, Purpose, Format, Operating vs Non-Operating Expenses, Net Profit or Net Loss
Balance Sheet: Meaning, Definition, Marshalling of Assets and Liabilities (Order of Liquidity vs Order of Permanence)
End-of-Year Adjustments in Financial Statements: Closing Stock (Cost or Net Realizable Value, whichever is lower)
Outstanding Expenses (Expenses Incurred but Not Paid) and Prepaid Expenses (Unexpired Expenses)
Accrued Income (Income Earned but Not Received) and Income Received in Advance (Unearned Income)
Depreciation on Fixed Assets: Meaning, Need, Straight Line Method vs Written Down Value (WDV) Method
Bad Debts and Provision for Bad and Doubtful Debts: Concept, Calculation, Treatment in P&L and Balance Sheet
Provision for Discount on Debtors and Creditors, Interest on Capital, Interest on Drawings, Interest on Bank Loans

units.title: Ratio Analysis & Financial Statement Interpretation
topics: Ratio Analysis: Meaning, Definition, Importance and Objectives in Financial Decision Making
Limitations of Ratio Analysis: Historical Data Dependence, Inflation Distortion, Window Dressing, Lack of Qualitative Factors
Classification of Accounting Ratios: Liquidity, Solvency / Leverage, Profitability, and Activity / Turnover Ratios
Liquidity Ratios: Current Ratio (Formula, Standard Benchmark 2:1, Significance), Quick Ratio / Acid Test Ratio (Standard Benchmark 1:1)
Absolute Liquid Ratio / Cash Ratio: Cash + Marketable Securities to Current Liabilities
Solvency Ratios: Debt-Equity Ratio (Long-Term Debt to Shareholders' Equity, Benchmark 2:1), Proprietary Ratio, Total Assets to Debt Ratio
Interest Coverage Ratio (Debt Service Ratio): EBIT / Fixed Interest Charges, Measuring Default Risk
Activity / Turnover / Efficiency Ratios: Inventory / Stock Turnover Ratio (COGS / Average Inventory) and Inventory Holding Period (in days)
Debtors / Trade Receivables Turnover Ratio (Credit Sales / Average Receivables) and Average Collection Period
Creditors / Trade Payables Turnover Ratio (Credit Purchases / Average Payables) and Average Payment Period
Working Capital Turnover Ratio: Net Sales / Net Working Capital
Profitability Ratios: Gross Profit Ratio ((Gross Profit / Net Sales) * 100), Operating Profit Ratio, Operating Ratio
Net Profit Ratio ((Net Profit / Net Sales) * 100), Return on Capital Employed (ROCE / ROI), Return on Equity (ROE), Earnings Per Share (EPS)

units.title: Management Accounting, Cost Accounting & Standard Costing
topics: Introduction to Management Accounting: Meaning, Definition, Nature, Objectives, and Scope
Advantages and Limitations of Management Accounting, Role in Strategic Planning and Managerial Decision Making
Comparative Analysis: Financial Accounting vs Management Accounting (Audience, Time Horizon, Mandatory vs Optional)
Comparative Analysis: Cost Accounting vs Management Accounting (Scope, Quantitative vs Qualitative Focus)
The Management Accountant: Organizational Position, Roles, Responsibilities, Ethical Conduct (IMA Standards)
Cost Accounting Fundamentals: Definition of Cost, Costing, Cost Accounting, Cost Unit, Cost Center (Profit Center vs Investment Center)
Classification of Costs: By Element (Material, Labor, Expenses), By Function (Production, Admin, Selling), By Behavior (Fixed, Variable, Semi-Variable)
Standard Costing: Meaning, Concept, Objectives, Advantages and Limitations in Cost Control
Standard Costing vs Historical Costing, Standard Costing vs Budgetary Control
Establishment of Cost Standards: Ideal Standards vs Attainable Current Standards for Direct Materials, Direct Labor, Overheads
Variance Analysis Overview: Favorable vs Unfavorable (Adverse) Variances, Material Cost Variances (Price and Usage Variances)
Labor Variances Overview: Labor Rate Variance, Labor Efficiency Variance, Idle Time Variance

units.title: Budgeting, Budgetary Control & Unit Costing (Cost Sheet)
topics: Budgeting Fundamentals: Definition of Budget, Characteristics, Distinction between Budgets and Forecasts
Essentials of an Effective Budgeting System: Management Support, Goal Congruence, Cost-Benefit Justification
Budgetary Control: Meaning, Objectives, Implementation Steps, Advantages and Operational Limitations
Classification of Budgets by Time Horizon: Long-Term Budgets, Short-Term Budgets, Current Budgets
Classification of Budgets by Function: Sales Budget, Production Budget, Raw Materials Budget, Cash Budget, Capital Expenditure Budget
Master Budget: Integration of all Functional Budgets, Summary Budgeted Profit & Loss and Budgeted Balance Sheet
Fixed Budget vs Flexible Budget: Concept, Need for Flexible Budgeting at Varying Activity Capacity Levels (60%, 80%, 100%)
Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB): Meaning, Peter Pyhrr Concept, Decision Packages, Cost-Benefit Ranking, Advantages over Incremental Budgeting
Unit Costing (Output Costing): Concept, Industries Applying Unit Costing (Mines, Brickworks, Paper Mills, Breweries)
Components of Total Cost: Prime Cost (Direct Material + Direct Labor + Direct Expenses), Works / Factory Cost
Cost of Production (Works Cost + Office/Admin Overheads), Total Cost / Cost of Sales (Cost of Production + Selling/Distribution Overheads)
Preparation of Cost Sheet: Detailed Step-by-Step Format with Work-in-Progress and Finished Goods Adjustments
Tender Price / Quotation Statement: Determination of Selling Price and Estimated Profit Margin for Enterprise Job Orders

units.title: Computer Networks, Topologies & Reference Models
topics: Computer Networks Overview: Definition, Goals, Resource Sharing, High Reliability, Scalability, Communication Medium
Data Communication Fundamentals: Components (Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Message, Protocols)
Data Transmission Modes: Simplex (Unidirectional), Half-Duplex (Both Directions, One at a Time), Full-Duplex (Simultaneous)
Network Topologies: Bus, Star, Ring, Mesh, Tree, and Hybrid Topologies (Advantages, Disadvantages, Fault Tolerance)
Network Classifications by Geographic Scope: Local Area Network (LAN), Metropolitan Area Network (MAN), Wide Area Network (WAN), PAN
Transmission Media: Guided Media (Twisted Pair Cable - UTP/STP, Coaxial Cable - Thinnet/Thicknet, Fiber Optic Cable - Single/Multi-mode)
Unguided (Wireless) Media: Radio Waves, Microwaves (Line-of-Sight), Infrared Transmission, Satellite Communication
Network Hardware Interconnection Devices: Repeaters, Hubs (Active vs Passive), Bridges, LAN Switches (Layer 2 Switching)
Internetworking Devices: Routers (Routing Tables, Packet Forwarding), Gateways (Protocol Translation)
Protocols and Layering Concepts: Protocol Hierarchy, Services vs Protocols, Interfaces, Encapsulation and Decapsulation (PDU)
OSI Reference Model: Seven Layers Overview (Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application)
TCP/IP Reference Model: Four Layers Overview (Network Access, Internet, Transport, Application) and Comparison with OSI Model

units.title: Network Models, Layer Functionalities & Protocols
topics: Network Architecture Paradigms: Client-Server Architecture (Dedicated Servers) vs Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Architecture
Physical Layer Functionalities: Bit Representation, Line Coding (NRZ, Manchester, Differential Manchester), Data Rate Bounds (Nyquist & Shannon Theorems)
Data Link Layer Functionalities: Framing, Bit Stuffing, Byte Stuffing, Error Control (Parity, Checksum, Cyclic Redundancy Check - CRC)
Flow Control Mechanisms: Stop-and-Wait ARQ, Sliding Window Protocols (Go-Back-N ARQ, Selective Repeat ARQ)
Medium Access Control (MAC) Sublayer: Channel Allocation, Pure ALOHA vs Slotted ALOHA (Efficiency Derivation)
Carrier Sense Multiple Access (CSMA): 1-Persistent, Non-Persistent, p-Persistent CSMA Protocols
CSMA/CD (Collision Detection) in Ethernet (IEEE 802.3): Minimum Frame Size Formula, Exponential Backoff Algorithm
CSMA/CA (Collision Avoidance) in Wireless LANs (IEEE 802.11): RTS/CTS Handshake, Interframe Spacing (DIFS, SIFS)
Network Layer Functionalities: Packet Switching vs Circuit Switching vs Message Switching, Routing Strategies (Static vs Dynamic)
Transport Layer Functionalities: End-to-End Delivery, Port Addressing, Multiplexing and Demultiplexing
Transmission Control Protocol (TCP): Connection-Oriented, 3-Way Handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK), Flow Control (Sliding Window), Congestion Control
User Datagram Protocol (UDP): Connectionless, Lightweight, Header Format (8 Bytes), Real-Time Streaming and Voice Applications

units.title: Addressing, Internet Protocol & Routing Algorithms
topics: Logical Addressing in TCP/IP: IPv4 32-Bit Address Space, Dotted-Decimal Notation, Binary Representation
Classful Addressing: Class A, Class B, Class C, Class D (Multicast), Class E (Experimental), Default Subnet Masks
Subnetting & Supernetting: Subnet Masking, Calculating Network ID, Broadcast ID, Number of Usable Host IP Addresses
Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR): Slash (/) Notation, Prefix Length, Hierarchical Route Aggregation
IPv4 Datagram Header Format: Version, IHL, Type of Service (ToS), Total Length, Identification, Flags (DF, MF), Fragment Offset, TTL, Protocol, Header Checksum
IP Packet Fragmentation and Reassembly: MTU Constraints, Fragmentation Calculations
IPv6 Addressing Architecture: 128-Bit Address Space, Colon-Hexadecimal Notation, Zero Compression Rules (::)
IPv6 Header Format: Fixed 40-Byte Header, Extension Headers, Advantages over IPv4 (Massive Space, Built-in IPSec, Simplified Header)
IPv4 to IPv6 Transition Mechanisms: Dual Stack, Tunneling (6to4), Network Address Translation - Protocol Translation (NAT-PT)
Address Resolution Protocol (ARP): Mapping IP Address to Physical MAC Address, ARP Request (Broadcast) & ARP Reply (Unicast), ARP Cache
Reverse Address Resolution Protocol (RARP), BOOTP, and Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) DORA Process (Discover, Offer, Request, Acknowledge)
Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP): Error Reporting (Destination Unreachable, Time Exceeded), Query Messages (Echo Request/Reply for ping)
Internet Group Management Protocol (IGMP): Multicast Group Joining and Membership Maintenance, Multicast Routing Overview

units.title: Application Layer Protocols & Network Management
topics: Application Layer Overview: Client-Server Programming Paradigm, Socket API (Socket, Bind, Listen, Accept, Connect, Send, Recv)
Domain Name System (DNS): Distributed Hierarchical Database, Name Space (Root, TLD, Second-Level, Subdomains)
DNS Operation: Recursive vs Iterative Query Resolution, DNS Caching, DNS Resource Records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, PTR)
Dynamic DNS (DDNS): Automated IP Address Mapping for Dynamic Host Configurations
Remote Logging - TELNET: Virtual Terminal Protocol, Network Virtual Terminal (NVT), Security Vulnerabilities (Plaintext Passwords)
Secure Shell (SSH): Encrypted Remote Terminal Connection, Public-Key Authentication, Port Forwarding / Tunneling
Electronic Mail Architecture: User Agent (MUA), Message Transfer Agent (MTA), Message Access Agent (MAA)
Email Protocols: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP, Port 25/587), Post Office Protocol (POP3, Port 110), Internet Message Access Protocol (IMAP4, Port 143)
File Transfer Protocol (FTP): Dual Connection Architecture (Control Connection Port 21, Data Connection Port 20), Active vs Passive FTP Modes
Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP): Client-Server Request-Response Model, Uniform Resource Identifier (URI/URL)
HTTP Methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, HEAD), Status Codes (200 OK, 301 Redirect, 404 Not Found, 500 Server Error)
Persistent vs Non-Persistent HTTP, HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, Cookies and Web Caching
Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP): Architecture (Manager, Agent, MIB, SMI), SNMP Operations (Get, Set, Trap), UDP Port 161/162

units.title: Network Security, Cryptography & Secure Protocols
topics: Network Security Fundamentals: Security Goals (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability - CIA Triad), Non-Repudiation, Authentication
Threats and Cyber Attacks: Passive Attacks (Eavesdropping, Traffic Analysis) vs Active Attacks (Masquerade, Replay, Modification, Denial of Service - DoS/DDoS)
Cryptography Basics: Plaintext, Ciphertext, Encryption, Decryption, Kerckhoffs's Principle
Symmetric-Key (Secret-Key) Cryptography: Principles, Advantages, Shared Secret Distribution Problem, DES, Triple-DES, Advanced Encryption Standard (AES)
Asymmetric-Key (Public-Key) Cryptography: Key Pairs (Public Key, Private Key), Mathematical Trapdoor Functions, RSA Algorithm
Message Authentication & Integrity: Cryptographic Hash Functions (MD5, SHA-256), Collision Resistance, Message Authentication Codes (MAC / HMAC)
Digital Signatures: Signing with Private Key, Verification with Public Key, Non-Repudiation Proof, Digital Certificates (X.509 Standard, Certificate Authority - CA)
Key Management & Distribution: Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange Algorithm (Discrete Logarithm Problem)
Network Layer Security - IP Security (IPSec): Architecture, Authentication Header (AH), Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP), Transport Mode vs Tunnel Mode
Transport Layer Security (TLS / SSL): Handshake Protocol, Record Protocol, HTTPS (Port 443), Securing Web Transactions
Application Layer Security: Pretty Good Privacy (PGP) for Email Security (Confidentiality, Authentication, Compression, Radix-64 Conversion)
Perimeter Defense: Firewalls (Packet Filtering Firewalls, Stateful Inspection Firewalls, Application Proxy Firewalls), Virtual Private Networks (VPNs - IPsec/SSL VPNs)

units.title: Introduction to Software Engineering & Life Cycle Models
topics: Introduction to Software Engineering: Definition, IEEE Definition, Software Crisis, Software Myths (Management, Customer, Practitioner Myths)
Software Characteristics: Software is Engineered not Manufactured, Software Does Not 'Wear Out' (Bathtub Curve vs Software Curve)
Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC): Core Phases (Requirement, Analysis, Design, Coding, Testing, Deployment, Maintenance)
Waterfall Model (Classical & Iterative): Sequential Lifecycle, Gate Reviews, Advantages, Limitations (Inflexible to Requirement Changes)
Prototyping Model: Working Mockups, User Feedback Loop, Throwaway vs Evolutionary Prototyping
Rapid Application Development (RAD) Model: Component-Based Construction, Time-Boxing, High-Speed Development Requirements
Evolutionary & Incremental Models: Delivering Working Increments, Staged Development, Managing Changing Requirements
Spiral Model (Barry Boehm): Risk-Driven Framework, Four Quadrants (Objective Setting, Risk Assessment & Reduction, Development & Validation, Planning Next Phase)
Agile Methodologies: Agile Manifesto (4 Values, 12 Principles), Scrum Framework (Product Owner, Scrum Master, Sprints, Daily Standup), Extreme Programming (XP)
Capability Maturity Model (CMM / CMMI): Five Maturity Levels (Initial, Repeatable, Defined, Managed, Optimizing), Key Process Areas (KPAs)
Software Quality Concepts: Quality Attributes (ISO/IEC 9126, McCall's Quality Factors), Quality Assurance (SQA) vs Quality Control
Software Metrics & Measurement: Product Metrics vs Process Metrics vs Project Metrics, Token Count (Halstead's Software Science), Lines of Code (LOC)

units.title: Requirements Analysis, Specification (SRS) & Modeling
topics: Requirements Engineering Process: Inception, Elicitation, Elaboration, Negotiation, Specification, Validation, Management
Requirements Elicitation Techniques: Interviews, Questionnaires, FAST (Facilitated Application Specification Techniques), JAD, Brainstorming
Types of Requirements: Functional Requirements (User Interactions, System Behaviors) vs Non-Functional Requirements (Performance, Security, Reliability)
Software Requirements Specification (SRS): Meaning, Importance, Target Audience, IEEE 830 Recommended Practice for SRS
Characteristics of a Good SRS: Correct, Unambiguous, Complete, Consistent, Ranked for Importance/Stability, Verifiable, Modifiable, Traceable
Specification Languages & Formal Methods: Natural Language, Structured English, Z-Notation, Finite State Machines (FSM)
Requirements Validation: Requirements Reviews, Walkthroughs, Audits, Prototyping, Acceptance Test Generation
Requirements Monitoring and Control: Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM - Forward and Backward Traceability), Change Control Boards (CCB)
Structured Analysis Modeling: Data Flow Diagrams (DFD - Level 0 Context Diagram, Level 1, Level 2 Decomposition Rules), Data Dictionaries
Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERD) in Requirements Modeling: Entities, Attributes, Relationships, Cardinality
Object-Oriented Analysis (OOA) Modeling with UML: Use Case Diagrams (Actors, Use Cases, <<include>>, <<extend>> Relationships)
UML Structural and Behavioral Diagrams: Class Diagrams, Sequence Diagrams, Statechart Diagrams, Activity Diagrams

units.title: Software Project Planning, Cost Estimation & SCM
topics: Software Project Management Overview: The 4 P's (People, Product, Process, Project), Project Manager Roles
Software Project Estimation: Size-Oriented Metrics (KLOC), Function-Oriented Metrics (Function Point Analysis - FPA)
Function Point Analysis (Albrecht): Five Function Types (ILF, EIF, EI, EO, EQ), Complexity Weighting, Value Adjustment Factor (VAF), FP Formula
Empirical Estimation Models: COCOMO Model (Constructive Cost Model by Barry Boehm), Basic COCOMO Modes (Organic, Semidetached, Embedded)
COCOMO Mathematical Equations: Effort = a * (KLOC)^b (Person-Months), Development Time = c * (Effort)^d (Months)
Intermediate COCOMO: Cost Drivers (Product, Hardware, Personnel, Project Attributes), Effort Multipliers (EAF)
Detailed COCOMO (COCOMO II): Application Composition, Early Design, Post-Architecture Estimation Models
Project Scheduling & Tracking: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), Task Networks, Effort Distribution (40-20-40 Rule)
Critical Path Method (CPM) and PERT: Earliest Start/Finish, Latest Start/Finish, Slack Time, Gantt Charts, Milestone Tracking
Software Team Organizations: Democratic Decentralized (DD), Controlled Decentralized (CD), Controlled Centralized (Chief Programmer Team)
Risk Management: Reactive vs Proactive Risk Strategies, Risk Identification, Risk Projection (Impact and Likelihood Rating), RMMM Plan
Software Configuration Management (SCM): Need for SCM, Baselines, SCM Process (Identification, Version Control, Change Control, Configuration Auditing)

units.title: Software Design Principles, Architecture & Strategies
topics: Software Design Concept: Transforming Analysis Model to Design Model, Design Quality Guidelines
Fundamental Design Concepts: Abstraction (Data, Procedural), Architecture, Modularity, Information Hiding (Parnas Principle)
Functional Independence: Cohesion and Coupling (The Golden Rule: High Cohesion and Low Coupling)
Types of Cohesion (Worst to Best): Coincidental, Logical, Temporal, Procedural, Communicational, Sequential, Functional Cohesion
Types of Coupling (Worst to Best): Content, Common (Global), Control, Stamp (Data Structure), Data, Uncoupled
Architectural Design Styles: Data-Centered (Repository/Blackboard), Data-Flow (Pipe-and-Filter), Call-and-Return, Layered Architecture, Client-Server
Structured Design Methodology: Structure Charts, Transform Analysis (Transform Center Flow) vs Transaction Analysis
Object-Oriented Design (OOD): SOLID Design Principles (Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion)
Design Patterns: Creational (Singleton, Factory Method), Structural (Adapter, Decorator), Behavioral (Observer, Strategy)
User Interface (UI) Design: Golden Rules (Theo Mandel - Place User in Control, Reduce Memory Load, Make UI Consistent), Usability Engineering
Design Specification and Verification: Design Walkthroughs, Critical Design Reviews (CDR), Design Translation Process (Mapping Design to Source Code)
Design Metrics: Architectural Complexity Metrics, Cyclomatic Complexity (Thomas McCabe: V(G) = E - N + 2P or P + 1)

units.title: Software Testing, Maintenance, Reliability & Reengineering
topics: Software Testing Fundamentals: Verification vs Validation (V&V - Boehm's Question), Error vs Fault (Defect/Bug) vs Failure
Testing Psychology & Principles: Exhaustive Testing is Impossible, Pesticide Paradox, Early Testing Saves Costs
White-Box (Glass-Box / Structural) Testing: Basis Path Testing, Control Flow Graphs (CFG), Cyclomatic Complexity Formula
Coverage Criteria: Statement Coverage, Branch / Decision Coverage, Condition Coverage, Path Coverage
Black-Box (Functional / Behavioral) Testing: Equivalence Partitioning (Valid and Invalid Classes), Boundary Value Analysis (BVA)
Specialized Black-Box Techniques: Cause-Effect Graphing, Decision Table Testing, Error Guessing
Strategic Levels of Testing: Unit Testing (Stubs and Drivers), Integration Testing (Top-Down, Bottom-Up, Big-Bang, Sandwich)
System Testing (Sanity, Smoke, Stress, Load, Performance, Security Testing), Regression Testing, Acceptance Testing (Alpha & Beta Testing)
Debugging Process & Strategies: Brute Force, Backtracking, Cause Elimination, Automated Debugging Tools
Software Maintenance: Meaning, Need, Categories of Maintenance (Corrective, Adaptive, Perfective, Preventive Maintenance)
Software Maintenance Cost Drivers: Lehman's Laws of Software Evolution, Reverse Engineering and Software Reengineering Cycle
Software Reliability and Availability: Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF = MTTF + MTTR), Availability Formula (A = MTTF / (MTTF + MTTR))
Cleanroom Software Engineering Approach: Zero-Defect Philosophy, Formal Specification, Statistical Usage Testing without Unit Testing
Software Reuse & Standards: Component-Based Software Engineering (CBSE), IEEE Software Engineering Standards (IEEE 730, 829, 830, 1012, 1074)
